title: A Bochner Weitzenb\"ock Decomposition for Cellular Sheaf Laplacians, Curvature and Neural Sheaf Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.28455v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We extend the Bochner-Weitzenb\"ock decomposition to cellular sheaf Laplacians, splitting it into a positive semidefinite term, the Bochner sheaf Laplacian, and a block diagonal term, the Forman curvature. We show that the Bochner Laplacians form a class of cellular sheaves that extends both connection and matrix-weighted Laplacians, and generalizes signed graphs to $d$ dimensions. We give a holonomy characterization of their kernel, prove the related Cheeger inequalities, and attach to them a random walk that generalizes the Gremban expansion. For the Forman term, we prove a discrete Bochner theorem, which bounds the first cohomology of a cellular sheaf with nonnegative curvature, and we read the whole decomposition as an opinion-dynamics model. We then apply this machinery to Sheaf Neural Networks, whose learnt Laplacian is otherwise unobserved. The Bochner interpretation yields a node-level conviction score that acts as an operation

translated_title: 胞腔层拉普拉斯算子、曲率与神经层扩散的Bochner-Weitzenböck分解
translated_abstract: 我们将Bochner-Weitzenböck分解扩展到胞腔层拉普拉斯算子，将其拆分为一个半正定项（Bochner层拉普拉斯算子）和一个块对角项（Forman曲率）。我们证明Bochner拉普拉斯算子构成一类胞腔层，它同时扩展了联络拉普拉斯算子和矩阵加权拉普拉斯算子，并将带符号图推广到$d$维。我们给出了其核的和乐刻画，证明了相关的Cheeger不等式，并为其附加了一个推广Gremban展开的随机游走。对于Forman项，我们证明了一个离散Bochner定理，该定理对具有非负曲率的胞腔层的第一上同调给出界，并且我们将整个分解解读为一个观点动力学模型。随后我们将这一机制应用于层神经网络，此类网络学习到的拉普拉斯算子通常是不可观测的。Bochner解释产生了一个节点级的信念得分，它作为一种操作……
tldr: 本文将Bochner-Weitzenböck分解推广到胞腔层拉普拉斯算子，将其分解为Bochner层拉普拉斯算子与Forman曲率两个部分，建立了相应的和乐刻画、Cheeger不等式与离散Bochner定理，并将该理论应用于层神经网络，得到节点级信念得分等新工具。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the Bochner-Weitzenböck decomposition to cellular sheaf Laplacians, splitting it into the Bochner sheaf Laplacian and the Forman curvature, establishes holonomy characterizations, Cheeger inequalities and a discrete Bochner theorem, and applies the framework to Sheaf Neural Networks to yield a node-level conviction score.
